home.subtitle: TUNCIS 2026 brings together on October 23–24, 2026 in Sousse an intentionally small community (places are limited) around a dual ambition.
home.para1: Reconnect Tunisian research, locally and internationally. Many Tunisian researchers work today in European laboratories, often at the highest level of their discipline, and maintain ties with colleagues back home that are more affective than operational. TUNCIS aims to transform these ties into real collaborations.
home.para2: Bridge research and industrial practice. Between a published result and an AI system actually running in production, the gap remains considerable.

imed.bio: Director General of ENSIIE, France, and President of TunAISia. Distinguished Professor in Information Systems, qualified to lead research in computer science and management sciences. His current research focuses on digital intelligence, digital transformation of organizations, governance of massive data, and quantum computing. He also conducts foresight work on emerging technologies and their societal impacts.

narjes.bio: Director of ENSI (Ecole Nationale des Sciences de l’Informatique) and Director of the RIADI Laboratory, University of Manouba, Tunisia. A Professor in the Department of Information Systems and Decision Engineering, she teaches Software Engineering and Artificial Intelligence. She holds an engineering diploma from ENSEEIHT Toulouse, a PhD from the University of Toulouse 1, and an HDR from ENSI. Her research focuses on modeling and simulation of complex socio-technical systems, information systems, and multi-agent systems. She was also a Fulbright scholar at the University of California, Irvine.

takoua.bio: Associate Professor at ENISo (National School of Engineers of Sousse), University of Sousse, and a researcher at the SERCOM Laboratory, Polytechnic School of Tunisia, University of Carthage. She holds an engineering degree from ENSIMAG (Grenoble, France), a PhD from Grenoble University, and an HDR from the University of Carthage. Her research focuses on Big Data, IoT, and Cloud Computing. She is also an NVIDIA Ambassador in Generative AI.

about.title: About TunAISia & AIS
about.subtitle: The academic leadership and global community driving TUNCIS 2026.
about.tunaisiaDesc1: TunAISia is the official Tunisian Chapter of the Association for Information Systems (AIS). It brings together researchers, university professors, PhD candidates, and technology practitioners across Tunisia and the diaspora.
about.tunaisiaDesc2: TunAISia serves as a scientific bridge connecting Tunisian higher education institutions and research laboratories with the global Information Systems academic ecosystem, driving digital transformation, research excellence, and industry collaboration.
tunaisiaMissions: Promote scientific research and academic excellence in Information Systems in Tunisia.
Strengthen interdisciplinary partnerships between universities, research labs, and digital industries.
Support doctoral candidates and early-career scholars through research consortiums, workshops, and international academic mentoring.
Organize premier scientific conferences, thematic workshops, and high-level training events such as TUNCIS 2026.
Represent Tunisia within the international Association for Information Systems community.
about.aisDesc1: Founded in 1994, the Association for Information Systems (AIS) is the premier global professional association for individuals and organizations leading the research, teaching, practice, and study of information systems worldwide.
about.aisDesc2: AIS serves thousands of members across more than 100 countries. It publishes top-tier scientific journals (including JAIS and CAIS), sponsors flagship international conferences (ICIS, AMCIS, ECIS), and establishes curricular guidelines for academic excellence in digital and information systems education.
aisMissions: Publish world-leading peer-reviewed research in digital technologies, data governance, and AI.
Provide an international platform for academic networking, conferences, and knowledge exchange.
Set global standards for information systems curricula, education, and career development.
Empower regional chapters across the globe to advance local research and technological innovation.
about.partnershipDesc: TUNCIS 2026 is co-organized under the academic patronage of TunAISia and AIS. Together with our university partners, research laboratories, and industrial sponsors, this conference serves as Tunisia’s premier international gathering for AI innovation and digital systems excellence.

nvidiaPage.badge: Official NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute (DLI) Training
nvidiaPage.title: Rapid Application Development with LLMs
nvidiaPage.heroSubtitle: Delivered by Horizon University in partnership with the NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute (DLI) during TUNCIS 2026.
nvidiaPage.accreditation: Accredited by NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute
nvidiaPage.courseDesc: This hands-on course provides a practical introduction to developing enterprise applications with large language models. Participants explore transformers, Hugging Face models, NLP pipelines, multimodal architectures, scalable text generation, and LangChain-based agentic workflows, culminating in the development of an integrated LLM-powered application.
nvidiaPage.officialLinkText: View Official NVIDIA DLI Course Page
nvidiaPage.curriculumDesc: Master cutting-edge generative AI and LLM tools through guided practical lab sessions:

topics.title: Transformers & Foundation Models
topics.desc: Understanding transformer architecture, self-attention mechanisms, and the modern foundation model landscape.

topics.title: Hugging Face Ecosystem & NLP Pipelines
topics.desc: Navigating the Hugging Face Hub, utilizing pre-trained pipelines for classification, summarization, and token generation.

topics.title: Scalable Text Generation & Prompt Design
topics.desc: Best practices in instruction prompting, sampling strategies, context window management, and optimization techniques.

topics.title: Multimodal Architectures
topics.desc: Working with multimodal foundation models combining natural language processing with vision and document analysis.

topics.title: LangChain & Agentic Workflows
topics.desc: Building autonomous LLM chains, tools integration, memory management, and structured output generation.

topics.title: Enterprise Application Deployment
topics.desc: End-to-end integration and testing of a complete LLM-powered production-ready application.

benefits.title: Globally Recognized Credential
benefits.desc: Earn an official certificate from the NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute (DLI), verifiable online and recognized worldwide.

benefits.title: Accelerated Cloud GPU Workstations
benefits.desc: Gain hands-on practice in dedicated cloud environments powered by high-performance NVIDIA GPUs.

benefits.title: Certified University Instructors
benefits.desc: Guided step-by-step by certified instructors from Horizon University throughout the training track.

nvidiaPage.calloutTitle: Ready to master enterprise LLMs with NVIDIA?
nvidiaPage.calloutSubtitle: Seats for the certified hands-on track are strictly limited to guarantee dedicated GPU workstations and personalized mentoring.
